The technical loan spelling, traditional lexical forms and full inflection remain insufficiently checked. Ordinary spaces before suffixes also bypass script-sensitive suffix shaping. Unicode 17 describes MVS for this role and legacy NNBSP compatibility, so a blind whitespace replacement is not enough.
